cues.text: Don’t you wish for death when you’re feeling weak!
Hardships aren’t as hard as they seem to be!
Sure, say that all you want, you’re not fooling me
cues.translation: 그런 말은 얼마든 해 봐, 난 속지 않아

cues.text: With those words you never mean.
While I don’t care to die, I don’t mind a bit
But someone I love? …God, I think I’d wish I did
cues.translation: 내가 사랑하는 사람이면? …세상에, 달랐으면 하고 바라겠지

cues.text: I suppose “Because I won’t like it”
Is all my ego is
Happy to gaze upon the pain of the haven’t-met,
Cowering in our hatred has become a fashion trend
cues.translation: 증오 속에 웅크리는 게 유행이 되어 버렸어

cues.text: Even so, we’re supposed to “live a peaceful life”?
Even though I bet it’s nice, I bet we’ve tried
Someone succumbs behind the colors of the monitor
Deep in grief, another weeps by singing in their honor
cues.translation: 깊은 슬픔에 잠긴 또 누군가는 그를 기리며 노래해

cues.text: Hearing that song, a humming young boy wandered
Off with a knife and an offer
Everybody hated well by life itself, we’ll never know
cues.translation: 우리 모두 삶 자체의 미움을 받지만, 결코 알지 못해

cues.text: Why they force code and ego on the radio
cues.translation: 왜 그들이 가치관과 이기심을 전파에 강요하는지

cues.text: Day-to-day, they’re singing out “I’ll take you down”, but then again,
Who takes when they’re really being generous?
Everybody hated well by life itself, we’ll never know
cues.translation: 우리 모두 삶 자체의 미움을 받지만, 결코 알지 못해

cues.text: Why “I want to die” is treated like another joke
cues.translation: 왜 ‘죽고 싶다’는 말이 또 하나의 농담처럼 취급되는지

cues.text: That world where we see the worth in growing old,
cues.translation: 늙어 가는 데서 가치를 보는 그 세상을

cues.text: Anybody hated well by life itself will never know.
cues.translation: 삶 자체의 미움을 받는 누구도 결코 알지 못해
